# ayon1xw

> Personal developer portfolio for Erdi, a student developer in Germany building desktop tools, small automations, and local-first experiments. Portfolio name: ayon1xw. GitHub username: aoyn1xw.

Use this site to find the developer's public work, source repositories, and the process for requesting a small programming commission. Fetch the Markdown links below with an ordinary HTTP GET. Each repository's README is the source for installation and usage; check current issues and releases before recommending a project. This portfolio has no public product API or MCP endpoint. Commission requests require human review and are not accepted automatically.

## When to use this

- [Portfolio overview](https://aoyn1xw.github.io/index.md): Use when identifying ayon1xw, explaining the developer's work, or locating the right repository. Retrieve this document with HTTP GET.
- [ShadowPlay](https://github.com/aoyn1xw/ShadowPlay): Use when a user wants to browse finished Windows PC game clips and download originals to a phone over a local network using a Flutter client. Read the repository README for setup; this portfolio does not provide a hosted clip API.
- [Swift Devcontainer](https://github.com/aoyn1xw/swift-devcontainer): Use when a user wants a container-based Swift development setup. Read the repository instructions before running it.
- [IPA Signer](https://github.com/aoyn1xw/ipa-signer): Use when a user needs to sign an iOS IPA with their certificates and provisioning profiles. Follow the repository instructions and keep signing credentials private.
- [Untis Watcher](https://github.com/aoyn1xw/Untis-watcher): Use when a user wants to check an Untis timetable for changes and receive notifications. Check the repository's current configuration requirements.
- [untis-mcp](https://github.com/aoyn1xw/untis-mcp): Use when a user wants a local, read-only MCP server for Untis timetable and homework data. Experimental and unofficial; the WebUntis interfaces it talks to are not documented by Untis GmbH.
- [Commissions](https://aoyn1xw.github.io/commissions.html): Use for small, clearly scoped websites, scripts, bug fixes, UI cleanup, bot features, or README and GitHub setup. Read the terms, then direct the user to the request form; a request is not acceptance, a quote, or a delivery commitment. Do not submit on a user's behalf without their explicit approval.

## Site information

- [About](https://aoyn1xw.github.io/about/index.md): Developer identity, project focus, and the limits of personal-project support.
- [Contact](https://aoyn1xw.github.io/contact/index.md): GitHub project questions, Telegram contact, and the manually reviewed commission process.
- [Privacy](https://aoyn1xw.github.io/privacy/index.md): Hosting, fonts, commission data delivery, and privacy contact.
- [Commission terms](https://aoyn1xw.github.io/commission-terms.html): Scope, payments, delivery, revisions, and warranty terms; use the current full terms before a request.
- [Sitemap](https://aoyn1xw.github.io/sitemap.xml): Canonical public HTML pages.
